SELECT slot_name, active, wal_status, restart_lsn FROM pg_replication_slots
SELECT table_schema, table_name, engine FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE engine NOT IN ('InnoDB') AND table_schema NOT IN ('mysql','information_schema','performance_schema','sys')
SELECT table_schema, table_name, engine FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE engine NOT IN ('InnoDB') AND table_schema NOT IN ('mysql','information_schema','performance_schema','sys')
SELECT md5(string_agg(t::text, ',' ORDER BY id)) FROM t WHERE id BETWEEN ...
SELECT pid, usename, application_name, client_addr, state, sent_lsn, write_lsn, flush_lsn, replay_lsn, write_lag, flush_lag, replay_lag, sync_state, reply_time FROM pg_stat_replication
SELECT status, receive_start_lsn, written_lsn, flushed_lsn, latest_end_lsn, latest_end_time, slot_name, sender_host, sender_port FROM pg_stat_wal_receiver
SELECT application_name, pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), replay_lsn) AS replay_lag_bytes, replay_lag FROM pg_stat_replication
SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp()) AS reader_lag_seconds, pg_last_wal_receive_lsn(), pg_last_wal_replay_lsn(), pg_get_wal_replay_pause_state()

SELECT slot_name, slot_type, database, active, active_pid, wal_status, safe_wal_size, restart_lsn, confirmed_flush_lsn, pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), restart_lsn) AS retained_bytes, inactive_since, conflicting, invalidation_reason, failover, synced FROM pg_replication_slots
SELECT c.CHANNEL_NAME, c.SERVICE_STATE AS io_state, c.LAST_ERROR_NUMBER AS io_errno, c.LAST_QUEUED_TRANSACTION_ORIGINAL_COMMIT_TIMESTAMP FROM performance_schema.replication_connection_status c

SELECT w.CHANNEL_NAME, w.WORKER_ID, w.SERVICE_STATE, w.LAST_ERROR_NUMBER, w.LAST_ERROR_MESSAGE, w.LAST_APPLIED_TRANSACTION_ORIGINAL_COMMIT_TIMESTAMP, w.LAST_APPLIED_TRANSACTION_END_APPLY_TIMESTAMP FROM performance_schema.replication_applier_status_by_worker w

cases.sql: SELECT rolname, rolsuper, rolinherit, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb, rolcanlogin, rolreplication, rolbypassrls, rolconnlimit, rolvaliduntil FROM pg_roles ORDER BY rolname

SELECT r.rolname AS role, m.rolname AS member, g.rolname AS grantor, am.admin_option, am.inherit_option, am.set_option FROM pg_auth_members am JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = am.roleid JOIN pg_roles m ON m.oid = am.member LEFT JOIN pg_roles g ON g.oid = am.grantor ORDER BY r.rolname, m.rolname
SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE rolsuper

SELECT m.rolname FROM pg_roles m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'rds_superuser') AND m.rolname <> 'rds_superuser' AND pg_has_role(m.oid, (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'rds_superuser'), 'MEMBER')
SELECT rolname, rolcreaterole, rolbypassrls, rolreplication FROM pg_roles WHERE rolcanlogin AND (rolcreaterole OR rolbypassrls OR rolreplication)

SELECT r.rolname AS predefined_role, m.rolname AS member FROM pg_roles r JOIN pg_roles m ON pg_has_role(m.oid, r.oid, 'MEMBER') AND m.oid <> r.oid WHERE r.rolname IN ('pg_read_server_files','pg_write_server_files', 'pg_execute_server_program','pg_read_all_data', 'pg_write_all_data','rds_replication','rds_password')

SELECT n.nspname, c.relname, c.relkind, pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner, CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END AS grantee, pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor) AS grantor, a.privilege_type, a.is_grantable FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(c.relacl) a WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f','S') AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%'

SELECT n.nspname, pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner) AS owner, CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END AS grantee, a.privilege_type, a.is_grantable FROM pg_namespace n CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(COALESCE(n.nspacl, acldefault('n', n.nspowner))) a WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%' AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_temp%'

SELECT d.datname, CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END AS grantee, a.privilege_type FROM pg_database d CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(COALESCE(d.datacl, acldefault('d', d.datdba))) a

SELECT pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole) AS for_role, COALESCE(n.nspname, '(all schemas)') AS schema, d.defaclobjtype, CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END AS grantee, a.privilege_type, a.is_grantable FROM pg_default_acl d LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = d.defaclnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(d.defaclacl) a
SELECT ssl, version, cipher, bits FROM pg_stat_ssl WHERE pid = pg_backend_pid()

SELECT a.datname, a.usename, a.client_addr, a.application_name, a.backend_type, s.ssl, s.version, s.cipher FROM pg_stat_ssl s JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid = s.pid WHERE a.backend_type = 'client backend' ORDER BY s.ssl, a.usename
SELECT name, setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('ssl','ssl_min_protocol_version','ssl_max_protocol_version', 'ssl_ciphers','rds.force_ssl')
SELECT user, host, plugin, account_locked, password_expired, password_last_changed, password_lifetime, ssl_type FROM mysql.user ORDER BY user, host
SELECT FROM_USER, FROM_HOST, TO_USER, TO_HOST, WITH_ADMIN_OPTION FROM mysql.role_edges
SELECT USER, HOST, PRIV, WITH_GRANT_OPTION FROM mysql.global_grants
SHOW SESSION STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Ssl_version','Ssl_cipher')
SELECT id, user, host, connection_type FROM performance_schema.threads pst INNER JOIN information_schema.processlist isp ON pst.processlist_id = isp.id
SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES WHERE Variable_name IN ('require_secure_transport','tls_version')
SELECT user, host, ssl_type FROM mysql.user
SELECT user, host, is_role, plugin, ssl_type, default_role FROM mysql.user

SELECT user, host, JSON_VALUE(Priv, '$.plugin') AS plugin, JSON_VALUE(Priv, '$.account_locked') AS account_locked, JSON_VALUE(Priv, '$.password_last_changed') AS password_last_changed, JSON_VALUE(Priv, '$.password_lifetime') AS password_lifetime FROM mysql.global_priv
SELECT Host, User, Role, Admin_option FROM mysql.roles_mapping
SHOW SESSION STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Ssl_version','Ssl_cipher')
SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES WHERE Variable_name IN ('require_secure_transport','tls_version')
SELECT user, host, ssl_type FROM mysql.user
SELECT rolname, CASE WHEN rolpassword LIKE 'SCRAM-SHA-256$%' THEN 'scram-sha-256' WHEN rolpassword LIKE 'md5%' THEN 'md5' WHEN rolpassword IS NULL THEN 'none' END FROM pg_authid
